universe.description: OTC then NASDAQ/NYSE small-cap frauds and pumps

setup.rule: Identify paid pumps via newsletters/texts; check float 3-20M, borrow <200%
setup.quote: I subscribe to them and I gladly put my phone number there
I like to short sometimes uh for example midday parabolic

entry.rule: Short after volume fade or post-lockup extension on strength
entry.quote: volume fade is you know looking at Daily candles Etc to determine what my entry is going to be

stop.rule: Exit on borrow spike or squeeze signal
stop.quote: if I see for example once last year I remember I shorted a stock ... it went to 400 and I got out

exits.rule: Cover end-of-day or on report release; avoid overnight on low float
exits.quote: I'll cover at the end of the day or something like that because I don't want to hold it overnight

sizing.rule: Small size on low float; scale only when borrow cheap
sizing.quote: if it's over 200 fee rate on interactive brokers I'm just uh I'm gonna try my best not to short it

market_filter.quote: if there's institutional ownership present in a in a NASDAQ ... they won't break down as easily

ambiguities.issue: Some intraday technical rules mentioned but no concrete long-side rules exist
ambiguities.assumption: All rules are short-only and discretionary
